By: Mart-Marie Faure | Commission

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
For six years specialist surgeon Dr Soraya Patel has been on the Health Professionals Council of South Africa's radar. We ask why is she still allowed to practice and how is it possible that Arwyp Me

Unique Selling Point:
Dr Soraya Patel is a general surgeon specialising in laparoscopic and weight loss procedures. For the past six years there have been numerous complaint lodged at the HPCSA about long, unnecessary and botched surgeries. It is also alleged that the mortality rate is above average. But why is it that after so many years Dr Patel is still practicing and why did Arwyp Medical Centre allow her to practice there claiming that they did now know about any complaints against Dr Patel?

Summary:
On the 30th of April 2019 a group of concerned doctors practicing at Netcare Sunward Park Hospital sent a detailed letter of complaint about Dr. Soraya Patel after witnessing what they considered serious cases of malpractice, long theatre times and unnecessary procedures and lengthy stays in hospital. The doctors were supported by the Association of Surgeons who encouraged them to lodge the complaint. The doctors provided the names and information of deceased patients.
An investigator from the HPCSA started an investigation but left the before completing the investigation.
The complaint dragged on and by the 25th of September 2019 there was still no ruling. On the 15th of November 2019 Advocate Khumalo from the HPCSA recommended an investifation by an ad hoc comittee
to see if she needed to be suspended.8 Months after the complaint was lodged Patel was summoned to appear in front of the preliminary committee. However when she appeared Dr Mothabeng from Sunward park had added 8 new cases. Patel claimed this was unfair as she had no time to study the complaints and patient reports. Again the case was postponed to the 1-8 February 2020. Patel brought a court order as the HPCSA had not made any strides in the case. A hearing was held in November 2020 and the committee decided that Patel should not be suspended as she did not pose any imminent danger to the public and claimed that there was not enough evidence to suspend her. It took two years for this ruling. Dr Patel also claimed that the doctors obtained the patient files illegally and brought the complaint without the permission of the patients or their families. The doctors admitted to this however in the case of Mr Gopaul Ramsunder one of the Sunward doctors was asked by Patel to have a look at her patient. He informed her early in the morning that the patient was critical and needed to go back to theatre. Patel arrived in the early hours of the morning and took him to theatre at 02:00 . The anaesthetist's report said that he was in critical condition due to sepsis. The procedure took 4hours and 30 minutes. Two hours later Mr Ramsunder died.
Patel claimed Ramsunder had Crohn's disease and was not informed about it.His family claims that he did not have the disease and that Patel did not inform them about the procedure and that they did not sign consent.
With all of this information at hand the HPCSA did not ask for medical reports from Sunward Park nor did they speak to any of the family members. A proper investigation was not done .
From an inside source we were informed that inspectorate and investigation units do not have any doctors in their teams.The public is left to rehabilitation professionals and PhD holders to investigate complaints. They cannot read the clinical records with discernment and they cannon therefor make informed decisions on progressing the complaints. The investigator allocated has a Phd in Philosophy .
Patel stated in her charge against the HPCSA that she was unable to work after being suspended from Netcare and suffered serious financial loss. We know that this is not true . She started to practice at Arwyp Medical Centre on 1 December 2019. The hospital claims that she was vetted and had no issues to give her admission rights. For six years she practiced at Arwyp with many botched operations and mortalities reported. The hospital claims that they were not aware of any complaint but we are in possession of emails sent to management and case studies who will testify to the fact that numerous complaints were lodged.
Medical Aids have blocked Dr Patel and is being investigated for fraud.









Further information:
Dr Patel was allowed to practice six years after the first complaint against her was lodged at the HPCSA leaving a trial of botched operations and mortalities.
3 of these patients were in ICU at Arwyp hospital for months with life threatening and life long damage.
Dr Patel forced the families to sign documents preventing them from speaking to CB but in July the patients, Magda Bosch, Willem Steyn and Riaan Muller were moved to Millpark hospital where they underwent life saving surgery.

metadata.Unique Selling Point: Dr Soraya Patel is a general surgeon specialising in laparoscopic and weight loss procedures. For the past six years there have been numerous complaint lodged at the HPCSA about long, unnecessary and botched surgeries. It is also alleged that the mortality rate is above average. But why is it that after so many years Dr Patel is still practicing and why did Arwyp Medical Centre allow her to practice there claiming that they did now know about any complaints against Dr Patel?
metadata.Summary: On the 30th of April 2019 a group of concerned doctors practicing at Netcare Sunward Park Hospital sent a detailed letter of complaint about Dr. Soraya Patel after witnessing what they considered serious cases of malpractice, long theatre times and unnecessary procedures and lengthy stays in hospital. The doctors were supported by the Association of Surgeons who encouraged them to lodge the complaint. The doctors provided the names and information of deceased patients. An investigator from the HPCSA started an investigation but left the before completing the investigation. The complaint dragged on and by the 25th of September 2019 there was still no ruling. On the 15th of November 2019 Advocate Khumalo from the HPCSA recommended an investifation by an ad hoc comittee to see if she needed to be suspended.8 Months after the complaint was lodged Patel was summoned to appear in front of the preliminary committee. However when she appeared Dr Mothabeng from Sunward park had added 8 new cases. Patel claimed this was unfair as she had no time to study the complaints and patient reports. Again the case was postponed to the 1-8 February 2020. Patel brought a court order as the HPCSA had not made any strides in the case. A hearing was held in November 2020 and the committee decided that Patel should not be suspended as she did not pose any imminent danger to the public and claimed that there was not enough evidence to suspend her. It took two years for this ruling. Dr Patel also claimed that the doctors obtained the patient files illegally and brought the complaint without the permission of the patients or their families. The doctors admitted to this however in the case of Mr Gopaul Ramsunder one of the Sunward doctors was asked by Patel to have a look at her patient. He informed her early in the morning that the patient was critical and needed to go back to theatre. Patel arrived in the early hours of the morning and took him to theatre at 02:00 . The anaesthetist's report said that he was in critical condition due to sepsis. The procedure took 4hours and 30 minutes. Two hours later Mr Ramsunder died. Patel claimed Ramsunder had Crohn's disease and was not informed about it.His family claims that he did not have the disease and that Patel did not inform them about the procedure and that they did not sign consent. With all of this information at hand the HPCSA did not ask for medical reports from Sunward Park nor did they speak to any of the family members. A proper investigation was not done . From an inside source we were informed that inspectorate and investigation units do not have any doctors in their teams.The public is left to rehabilitation professionals and PhD holders to investigate complaints. They cannot read the clinical records with discernment and they cannon therefor make informed decisions on progressing the complaints. The investigator allocated has a Phd in Philosophy . Patel stated in her charge against the HPCSA that she was unable to work after being suspended from Netcare and suffered serious financial loss. We know that this is not true . She started to practice at Arwyp Medical Centre on 1 December 2019. The hospital claims that she was vetted and had no issues to give her admission rights. For six years she practiced at Arwyp with many botched operations and mortalities reported. The hospital claims that they were not aware of any complaint but we are in possession of emails sent to management and case studies who will testify to the fact that numerous complaints were lodged. Medical Aids have blocked Dr Patel and is being investigated for fraud.
metadata.Further information: Dr Patel was allowed to practice six years after the first complaint against her was lodged at the HPCSA leaving a trial of botched operations and mortalities. 3 of these patients were in ICU at Arwyp hospital for months with life threatening and life long damage. Dr Patel forced the families to sign documents preventing them from speaking to CB but in July the patients, Magda Bosch, Willem Steyn and Riaan Muller were moved to Millpark hospital where they underwent life saving surgery.
